requirements.description: Use entry.get_subentries_of_type() to process only expected subentry types and prevent compatibility issues when additional subentry types are introduced.

adjudication_reason: The reviewer requested using entry.get_subentries_of_type() to process only subentries of the expected type. The subsequent code explicitly replaces entry.subentries.items() with entry.get_subentries_of_type(SUBENTRY_TYPE_RECIPIENT), directly implementing the requested change. Therefore, the review comment is satisfied.
